cutaneous electrical stimulation modulated early (early-onset and/or late) auditory responses of first-and higher-order nucleus cells with regard to response magnitudes, latencies and/or burst spikings in a nucleus and/or cell-type-dependent manner.

cutaneous electrical stimulation modulates auditory responses of first-order and higher-order auditory nucleus cells in an early and/or late phase, and in a magnitude-, latency- and burst spiking-dependent manner.

subthreshold cutaneous electrical stimulation alters auditory responses with regard to response magnitudes, latencies and burst spiking in a robust manner, and the alterations are nucleus and/or cell-type specific.

the cross-modal alterations of the auditory response in the auditory thalamus by cutaneous electrical stimulations in anesthetized animals.
the neural mechanisms of cross-modal interaction in the auditory thalamus, with a focus on the somatosensory modulation of auditory responses.
cross-modal modulation of auditory thalamic cell activities by subthreshold cutaneous electrical stimulation.
